title: Walter — on home oxygen, needs a ride to charge his concentrator (English, PayPal)

voice.instructions: An older American man, slightly short of breath, calm and matter-of-fact, speaking slowly.

transcript: Hi, this is Walter. I'm on oxygen at home, and my power has been out since the storm. My concentrator's backup battery only has a few hours left. I need a ride to the warming center at the library so I can plug it in, or gas money so my neighbor can drive me. I live alone on Maple Street. You can send it to my PayPal, walter dot reyes 1947 at example dot com. Thank you.

extraction.summaryEn: Oxygen-dependent elder, power out since the storm and backup battery running low; needs a ride or gas money to reach the library warming center to charge his concentrator. Lives alone.
